figV2_paired_differences: Candidate D (levels + EO-minus-predicted-EO shape) minus each comparator, all shown, none selected. Left/middle: mean-over-repeats AUC difference with joint patient-bootstrap interval (small markers = individual repeats). Right: patient-level paired log-loss difference averaged over repeats (Remitter). Conditional on saved predictions. A positive AUC difference against A/C addresses incremental information; a chance-association permutation test cannot.
figV3_roc_pr: Remitter pooled out-of-fold predictions; thick = repeat 42 (prespecified primary), thin = 43/44. Dotted: chance / prevalence 0.48. Descriptive only; thresholds were fixed inside training folds.
figV4_calibration: Remitter calibration of pooled out-of-fold probabilities in five equal-count bins (thick = repeat 42; n per bin for 42). About +/-0.09 binomial noise per bin.
figV5_complete_case: Complete-case sensitivity (patients with complete EC and EO vectors, N=153 of 164). Blue: saved full-cohort predictions evaluated on complete patients only (descriptive; E01c shown for the same patients). Orange: models A-D refit with the saved outer folds restricted to complete patients (E01c not refit). Mean AUC over three repeats; no intervals shown (small N).
